recipes.description_en: Pork casing stuffed with minced pork and belly pounded together with a Northern red chilli paste and handfuls of fresh herbs (lemongrass, makrut lime leaf, coriander, spring onion, sawtooth coriander), then slowly grilled over low charcoal. 'Ua' means 'to stuff'. MFU's Chiang Rai database describes it as a way to preserve and fully use pork after festival slaughtering; it keeps about 1-3 days.

recipes.prep_ahead_en: Clean the casings first (they take the longest). The filled sausage can rest in the fridge overnight, which firms it and lets flavours develop. Soak dried large chillies 10 min if they are brittle.

steps.th: โขลกพริกแห้งเม็ดใหญ่ พริกขี้หนูแห้งกับเกลือให้ละเอียด ใส่รากผักชี ตะไคร้ กระเทียม หอมแดง ขมิ้น โขลกรวมกันหยาบๆ
steps.en: Pound the large dried chillies and dried bird's eye chillies with the salt until fine. Add coriander root, lemongrass, garlic, shallots and fresh turmeric; pound together to a coarse paste.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Paste is brick-red, moist, with visible flecks of lemongrass; the kitchen smells strongly of lemongrass and toasted chilli.
steps.tip_en: Pound the driest, hardest things first, wettest last - standard Thai paste order.

steps.th: ผสมหมูบด หมูสามชั้น กับพริกแกง ใส่ซอสปรุงรส น้ำตาล ขมิ้นผง ใบมะกรูด ต้นหอม ผักชี ผักชีฝรั่ง และน้ำ เคล้าให้เข้ากัน
steps.en: Combine both porks with the paste. Add seasoning sauce, sugar, ground turmeric, makrut leaf, spring onion, coriander, sawtooth coriander and water; mix thoroughly by hand.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Filling is evenly orange-yellow and slightly sticky.
steps.tip_en: Fry a teaspoon of filling to taste and adjust salt before stuffing.

steps.th: ล้างไส้หมูให้สะอาด เอาเยื่อไขมันที่หุ้มไส้ออก ล้างน้ำหลายครั้ง ล้างด้วยน้ำเกลือ (น้ำ 4 ถ้วย เกลือ 1 ช้อนโต๊ะ) แล้วน้ำปูนใส (น้ำปูนใส 2 ถ้วย น้ำ 2 ถ้วย) และน้ำเปล่า พักให้สะเด็ดน้ำ
steps.en: Wash the casings, peel off the fatty membrane, rinse several times squeezing out water, fat and slime. Rinse in salt water (4 cups water + 1 tbsp salt), then limewater (2 cups limewater + 2 cups water), then plain water. Drain.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Casings look translucent and smell neutral.
steps.tip_en: Limewater (น้ำปูนใส) is slaked-lime water, not lime juice.

steps.th: มัดปลายไส้ด้านหนึ่ง ใช้นิ้วเปิดปลายอีกด้าน กรอกไส้ทีละน้อยพร้อมไล่อากาศ มัดปลายให้แน่น ใช้ไม้แหลมจิ้มไล่อากาศ
steps.en: Tie one end of each casing. Open the other end with a finger (or funnel) and feed the filling in bit by bit, pushing out air. Tie off tightly. Prick air pockets with a pointed stick.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Sausage feels evenly firm but not drum-tight.
steps.tip_en: Overstuffing makes casings burst on the grill. MFU's version makes 6-inch lengths; many cooks coil one long sausage.

steps.th: ปิ้งบนเตาถ่านไฟอ่อนจนเหลืองหอมและสุกทั่ว
steps.en: Grill over low charcoal, turning often, until golden and cooked through.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Skin turns glossy golden-brown with a few charred spots; fat sizzles and drips; herbal smoke; juices run clear when pricked.
steps.tip_en: Low heat is the key - high heat burns the casing before the centre cooks. MFU notes it can also be deep-fried; some cooks grill over coconut husk.

steps.th: หั่นเป็นชิ้นพอคำ เสิร์ฟกับผักสด
steps.en: Slice into bite-size pieces and serve with fresh vegetables.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Cut surface is pinkish-orange with green herb flecks, no raw pink centre.

taste_profile.texture_en: Snappy casing, coarse juicy filling, lots of chewy herb bits.
taste_profile.description_th: หอมตะไคร้และใบมะกรูดเด่น เผ็ดกลางๆ เค็มนัว มันจากหมูสามชั้น
taste_profile.description_en: Dominated by lemongrass and makrut-lime aroma, medium chilli heat, salty-savoury with pork fat richness.

how_to_eat.th: หั่นเป็นแว่น กินกับข้าวนึ่ง (ข้าวเหนียว) ปั้นด้วยมือ แกล้มกะหล่ำปลี ผักชี พริกขี้หนูสด และขิงอ่อนซอย มักขึ้นขันโตกคู่กับน้ำพริกหนุ่มและแคบหมู
how_to_eat.en: Sliced into rounds and eaten with sticky rice (ข้าวนึ่ง khao nueng) rolled by hand, with raw cabbage, coriander, fresh chillies and thin slices of young ginger to cut the richness. Often served with nam phrik num and khaep mu on a khantok tray.
how_to_eat.when_eaten: any meal; very common as a take-away from markets
how_to_eat.sharing_etiquette_en: Slices go on a shared plate; take one or two at a time with your rice ball rather than piling your own plate.

recipes.food_safety_en: Cook fully - fresh pork filling is raw until grilled through. Clean casings well. Keep uncooked sausage refrigerated and cook within 1-3 days. Thailand's Department of Disease Control warns that raw or undercooked pork and raw pork blood (ลาบดิบ, หลู้, raw แหนม/จิ๊นส้ม, raw wild boar) can transmit Streptococcus suis (โรคไข้หูดับ, 'deaf-ear fever'): high fever, severe headache, stiff neck, vomiting and possible permanent deafness 3-5 days after eating; the North and Northeast have the most cases. Lime juice or red-ant eggs do NOT 'cook' the meat. Buy pork from inspected slaughterhouses/markets, use separate boards for raw and cooked, and cook until no pink remains.
common_mistakes_foreigners_en: Grilling on high heat (casing burns, centre raw)
Using lean mince only (dry, crumbly)
Substituting regular lime leaves or lime zest for makrut leaves
Eating it with a fork alone - it is designed to be eaten with sticky rice and raw vegetables
Forgetting young ginger, which locals use to cut the fat

recipes.prep_ahead_en: Boil and slice pork skin the day before. Plan 3-4 days of fermentation at warm room temperature before eating.

steps.th: บีบน้ำออกจากหมูบด
steps.en: Squeeze excess moisture out of the minced pork.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Meat is sticky and dense, not wet.

steps.th: หั่นหนังหมูต้มเป็นเส้นบางๆ
steps.en: Slice the boiled pork skin into thin strands.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Thin, even, noodle-like strips.

steps.th: โขลกกระเทียมกับเกลือให้ละเอียด คลุกกับหมูและหนังหมู ใส่ข้าวเหนียวที่ล้างแล้ว คลุกให้เข้ากัน พักไว้ 30 นาที
steps.en: Pound garlic with the salt, mix into the pork and skin, add the rinsed sticky rice and knead thoroughly; rest 30 minutes.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Mixture becomes tacky and holds together when squeezed.
steps.tip_en: Knead well (Pim's related หมูส้ม method kneads about 5 min) so salt is evenly distributed.

steps.th: ห่อด้วยใบตองหรือใส่ถุง บีบไล่อากาศให้หมด มัดให้แน่น
steps.en: Wrap tightly in banana leaves (tucking whole chillies in) or pack into bags, pressing out ALL air; tie firmly.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Parcels are hard and compact with no air pockets.
steps.tip_en: krua.co stresses squeezing out air; air pockets lead to spoilage.

steps.th: หมักไว้ที่อุณหภูมิห้อง 3-4 วันจะเริ่มเปรี้ยว
steps.en: Leave at room temperature 3-4 days until it turns sour, then refrigerate.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Pleasant clean sour smell; colour shifts from red-pink to paler pink; texture firms. Off, putrid or slimy = discard.
steps.tip_en: Refrigerate once sour to slow further souring.

taste_profile.texture_en: Firm, springy meat with chewy strands of skin.

how_to_eat.th: คนเหนือนิยมกินแบบสุก เช่น จิ๊นส้มหมก (หมกไฟอ่อนในใบตอง) หมกไข่ ใส่แกงผักปลัง กินกับข้าวนึ่ง พริกสด
how_to_eat.en: Locals mostly cook it: wrapped in banana leaf and roasted (jin som mok), with egg, or in kaeng phak plang (Malabar-spinach curry). Eaten with sticky rice, fresh chillies and raw vegetables.
how_to_eat.sharing_etiquette_en: Shared plate; pick a piece with your sticky-rice ball.

recipes.food_safety_en: Fermented pork is eaten raw by some people, but Thai health authorities specifically warn that raw แหนม carries Streptococcus suis risk, and a Department of Medical Sciences survey (2018, Northeast) found about 20% of community fermented products (naem, pla som) failed standards for food-poisoning bacteria. For visitors: eat it COOKED (grilled, mok, fried). At home: use very fresh inspected pork, clean hands and tools, correct salt, airtight packing, and refrigerate once sour. Thailand's Department of Disease Control warns that raw or undercooked pork and raw pork blood (ลาบดิบ, หลู้, raw แหนม/จิ๊นส้ม, raw wild boar) can transmit Streptococcus suis (โรคไข้หูดับ, 'deaf-ear fever'): high fever, severe headache, stiff neck, vomiting and possible permanent deafness 3-5 days after eating; the North and Northeast have the most cases. Lime juice or red-ant eggs do NOT 'cook' the meat. Buy pork from inspected slaughterhouses/markets, use separate boards for raw and cooked, and cook until no pink remains.
common_mistakes_foreigners_en: Assuming 'fermented = safe raw'
Leaving air in the parcel
Cutting the salt
Fermenting in the fridge from day one (it will not sour properly)

recipes.food_safety_en: Offal must be very fresh and fully cooked. Thailand's Department of Disease Control warns that raw or undercooked pork and raw pork blood (ลาบดิบ, หลู้, raw แหนม/จิ๊นส้ม, raw wild boar) can transmit Streptococcus suis (โรคไข้หูดับ, 'deaf-ear fever'): high fever, severe headache, stiff neck, vomiting and possible permanent deafness 3-5 days after eating; the North and Northeast have the most cases. Lime juice or red-ant eggs do NOT 'cook' the meat. Buy pork from inspected slaughterhouses/markets, use separate boards for raw and cooked, and cook until no pink remains.

steps.tip_en: Kham Phaka briefly stir-fries paste and chicken first until fragrant but not cooked; the Cookpad fish version mixes raw.

steps.th: ขยำเลือดหมูกับใบตะไคร้แล้วกรอง
steps.en: Squeeze the blood together with lemongrass leaves, then strain.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Smooth dark-red liquid, less metallic smell.
steps.tip_en: Removes clots and the 'fishy' blood smell.

steps.th: เจียวกระเทียมจนเหลือง เก็บน้ำมันไว้
steps.en: Fry garlic golden; keep the oil.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Golden, nutty-smelling, not brown.

steps.th: นวด (กั๊น) ข้าวสวยกับหมูบดและเลือดให้เข้ากัน ปรุงด้วยเกลือ น้ำตาล น้ำมันกระเทียม (บางสูตรผัดหมูกับเลือดก่อน)
steps.en: Knead (kan) the rice with the pork and blood until evenly red-brown; season with salt, sugar and garlic oil. (Wongnai's version stir-fries pork and blood first, then mixes in rice.)
steps.sensory_cue_en: Each grain is coated deep red; mix holds when squeezed.

steps.th: ห่อใบตองให้แน่น นึ่งจนสุก (ประมาณ 30 นาทีตามสูตร กพร.)
steps.en: Wrap tightly in banana leaf and steam until cooked - about 30 minutes (KPRU; only 10 minutes if the mix was pre-fried).
steps.sensory_cue_en: Parcels firm; inside turns uniformly brown with no red liquid.

steps.th: แกะห่อ ราดน้ำมันกระเทียม โรยกระเทียมเจียว เสิร์ฟกับพริกแห้งทอด หอมแดง แตงกวา ผักชี
steps.en: Unwrap, drizzle garlic oil, top with fried garlic; serve with fried chillies, shallot, cucumber and coriander.

taste_profile.texture_en: Soft, slightly sticky rice with a rich, iron-savoury depth; crunchy toppings.
taste_profile.description_th: มัน หอมกระเทียมเจียว เค็มนัว เผ็ดจากพริกแห้งทอดที่กินแนม
taste_profile.description_en: Savoury and garlicky with the deep mineral note of blood; heat comes from the fried chillies you add.

kham_mueang_taste_words.en: delicious (Kham Mueang; krua.co uses 'แหนมลำๆ')

how_to_eat.th: กินเป็นข้าวตอน โรยกระเทียมเจียว พริกแห้งทอด กัดกระเทียมสด หอมแดง แตงกวา
how_to_eat.en: A lunch dish: eat from the leaf with fried garlic and chillies, bites of raw garlic or shallot, and cucumber to refresh.

recipes.food_safety_en: Contains pork blood: it must be fresh, from an inspected source, and fully steamed (no red liquid). Never eat raw-blood dishes. Thailand's Department of Disease Control warns that raw or undercooked pork and raw pork blood (ลาบดิบ, หลู้, raw แหนม/จิ๊นส้ม, raw wild boar) can transmit Streptococcus suis (โรคไข้หูดับ, 'deaf-ear fever'): high fever, severe headache, stiff neck, vomiting and possible permanent deafness 3-5 days after eating; the North and Northeast have the most cases. Lime juice or red-ant eggs do NOT 'cook' the meat. Buy pork from inspected slaughterhouses/markets, use separate boards for raw and cooked, and cook until no pink remains.
common_mistakes_foreigners_en: Using sticky rice (the Shan version uses jasmine rice)
Under-steaming
Skipping the garlic oil - it's essential

recipes.cultural_notes_en: Khaosod notes 'เงี้ยว (ngiao)' was the Lanna name for Shan people, hence the alternative name khao ngiao. Shan people call themselves Tai (ไต); ngiao can be felt as a dated or derogatory exonym, so prefer 'khao kan jin' or 'Tai Yai food'. Khaosod also notes the Shan preference for non-glutinous rice at midday.

recipes.name_th: เนื้อทุบ (จิ้นตุ๊บ)

pronunciation.tip_en: Both syllables high and short; 'tup' ends in an unreleased p. ตุ๊บ = to pound/bash (Central ทุบ). Spellings vary: จิ้นตุ๊บ, จิ๊นตุ๊บ, จิ้นตุ้. Tones are Chiang Mai Northern Thai values (24 low-rising, 21 low-falling, 44ʔ high-level glottal, 33 mid, 42 high-falling, 45 high-rising), DERIVED by applying the Chiang Mai tone-box correspondences (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northern_Thai_language) to the Thai spelling: A1-3=24, A4=33, B1-3=21, B4=42, C1-3=44ʔ, C4=45, dead short 1-3=21, dead short 4=45, dead long 1-3=21, dead long 4=42; Kham Mueang spellings with ๊ treated as 45 and with ๋ as 24 (same convention as foundations_recipes.json). Not checked against native recordings.

pronunciation.tip_en: Rising tone, unaspirated k. Do not confuse with ไก่ kai (chicken, low tone) or ไข่ khai (egg). Tones are Chiang Mai Northern Thai values (24 low-rising, 21 low-falling, 44ʔ high-level glottal, 33 mid, 42 high-falling, 45 high-rising), DERIVED by applying the Chiang Mai tone-box correspondences (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northern_Thai_language) to the Thai spelling: A1-3=24, A4=33, B1-3=21, B4=42, C1-3=44ʔ, C4=45, dead short 1-3=21, dead short 4=45, dead long 1-3=21, dead long 4=42; Kham Mueang spellings with ๊ treated as 45 and with ๋ as 24 (same convention as foundations_recipes.json). Not checked against native recordings.

origin_province: Nan (Nan River - Tha Wang Pha, Phu Phiang)

recipes.description_th: ไก (Cladophora glomerata) สาหร่ายสีเขียวเส้นยาวที่ขึ้นบนหินในน้ำไหลใสสะอาด นำมาล้าง ตากเป็นแผ่น (ไกแผ่น) หรือคั่วบดเป็นไกยี ปรุงด้วยเกลือ งาคั่ว กระเทียมเจียว กินกับข้าวนึ่งและน้ำพริก
recipes.description_en: Kai is a long green freshwater alga (Cladophora glomerata) growing on rocks in clean, sunlit, flowing rivers - an indicator of clean water. It is washed, dried into sheets (kai phaen) and fried crisp, or toasted and crumbled into kai yi with salt, toasted sesame and fried garlic. High in protein, fibre and B vitamins.

steps.en: Cut the sheets into pieces.

steps.en: Flash-fry in hot oil a few seconds per side.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Turns bright green and crisp instantly; stop before it darkens.
steps.tip_en: The Lao Pha Khao Lao guide warns: 3-5 seconds per side - longer turns it bitter and burnt. (Frying time is from a Lao source; Nan practice presumably similar.)

how_to_eat.en: Kai yi with sticky rice and chilli dip (Thai PBS: nam phrik makhuea som, a tomato dip). Fried sheets as a beer snack. Fresh kai is made into ho nueng kai (steamed parcel), kaeng kai (curry) and khua kai (stir-fry).

recipes.food_safety_en: Buy sealed commercial sheets; only riverside communities harvest fresh kai. Kai grows only in clean water, so wild-harvest quality depends on river condition.
common_mistakes_foreigners_en: Over-frying (bitter)
Confusing ไก (weed) with ไก่ (chicken) when ordering
Thinking it's seaweed/nori - it's freshwater

recipes.name_en: Northern-style whole chicken steamed in curry paste

pronunciation.tip_en: 'kai' low (chicken), 'nueng' falling, 'mueang' mid. 'Mueang' here means 'local/Northern style'. Tones are Chiang Mai Northern Thai values (24 low-rising, 21 low-falling, 44ʔ high-level glottal, 33 mid, 42 high-falling, 45 high-rising), DERIVED by applying the Chiang Mai tone-box correspondences (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northern_Thai_language) to the Thai spelling: A1-3=24, A4=33, B1-3=21, B4=42, C1-3=44ʔ, C4=45, dead short 1-3=21, dead short 4=45, dead long 1-3=21, dead long 4=42; Kham Mueang spellings with ๊ treated as 45 and with ๋ as 24 (same convention as foundations_recipes.json). Not checked against native recordings.

recipes.description_th: ไก่บ้านทั้งตัวทาพริกแกงเหนือ (พริกแห้ง เมล็ดผักชี ตะไคร้ ข่า ขมิ้น รากผักชี กระเทียม หอมแดง กะปิ ใบมะกรูด) หมัก 30 นาที แล้วนึ่ง 45 นาที น้ำที่ได้ทำเป็นน้ำจิ้ม
recipes.description_en: Whole native chicken rubbed inside and out with a Northern paste and steamed; the paste from the cavity plus steaming juices becomes the dipping sauce. (Included as the sourced alternative to 'kai yang mueang', for which no Thai source was found.)

steps.th: โขลกพริกแห้งกับเกลือ ใส่เมล็ดผักชี ตะไคร้ ข่า ขมิ้น รากผักชี กระเทียม หอมแดง ตามลำดับความแห้ง ปรุงด้วยกะปิ น้ำปลา ใส่ใบมะกรูดฉีก
steps.en: Pound dry chilli with salt, then add coriander seed, lemongrass, galangal, turmeric, coriander root, garlic, shallot (driest first); season with shrimp paste and fish sauce; add torn makrut leaves.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Deep orange, very aromatic paste.

steps.th: ทาพริกแกงให้ทั่วทั้งตัวไก่ด้านในและนอก หมัก 30 นาที
steps.en: Rub the paste all over and inside the chicken; marinate 30 min.

steps.th: นึ่ง 45 นาที
steps.en: Steam, covered, 45 minutes.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Juices clear; thigh meat pulls away easily.

steps.th: ตักพริกแกงจากท้องไก่ ผสมผักชี น้ำปลา และน้ำจากการนึ่ง เป็นน้ำจิ้ม
steps.en: Scoop paste from the cavity, mix with coriander, fish sauce and steaming juices for a dip.

taste_profile.description_th: หอมสมุนไพร เผ็ดร้อน

how_to_eat.th: ฉีกไก่ จิ้มน้ำจิ้ม กินกับข้าวนึ่ง
how_to_eat.en: Tear the chicken by hand, dip in the paste sauce, eat with sticky rice.
how_to_eat.sharing_etiquette_en: Whole bird in the middle, everyone tears pieces.

recipes.food_safety_en: Steam until juices run clear at the thigh bone.
common_mistakes_foreigners_en: Using a large broiler chicken (needs longer steaming, softer texture)
recipes.cultural_notes_en: 'Mueang' as an adjective marks something as local Northern (khon mueang = Northern people, kham mueang = Northern speech).

recipes.description_th: ปลานิลหรือปลาทับทิมบั้ง ทาเกลือ ยัดไส้ด้วยพริก หอมแดง กระเทียม ตะไคร้ ขมิ้น และหมูสับ ปิ้งเตาถ่าน กินกับน้ำพริกหนุ่มหรือแจ่ว
recipes.description_en: Tilapia or red tilapia scored and salted, stuffed with chilli, shallot, garlic, lemongrass, turmeric and a little minced pork, grilled over charcoal; eaten with nam phrik num or jaew and raw vegetables. Community recipe shared on Lemon8 (social media) - medium confidence.

recipes.prep_ahead_en: Pound stuffing coarsely; mix lightly with pork.

steps.th: บั้งปลาด้านละ 2-3 รอย ทาเกลือบางๆ
steps.en: Score the fish 2-3 times per side, rub lightly with salt.

steps.th: ยัดไส้สมุนไพรผสมหมูสับในท้องปลา
steps.en: Stuff the belly with the herb-pork mixture.
steps.tip_en: Mix lightly so the stuffing doesn't go soggy.

steps.th: ปิ้งไฟกลาง กลับบ่อยช่วงแรก แล้วเพิ่มไฟให้หนังกรอบ
steps.en: Grill over medium charcoal, turning often at first, then raise the heat to crisp the skin.
steps.sensory_cue_en: Skin blisters and crisps, flesh at the thickest point is opaque and flakes; stuffing hot.
steps.tip_en: Brush with a little garlic oil near the end (optional).

taste_profile.description_th: หนังกรอบ เนื้อชุ่ม หอมตะไคร้ขมิ้น
taste_profile.description_en: Smoky, herby, salty skin with sweet flesh.

kham_mueang_taste_words.en: delicious (Kham Mueang; krua.co uses 'แหนมลำๆ')

how_to_eat.th: แกะเนื้อจิ้มน้ำพริกหนุ่มหรือแจ่ว กินกับข้าวนึ่ง แตงกวา ถั่วฝักยาว กะหล่ำปลี
how_to_eat.en: Pick flesh off with fingers or spoon, dip in nam phrik num or jaew, eat with sticky rice, cucumber, long beans, cabbage.
how_to_eat.sharing_etiquette_en: Whole fish shared; take from your side of the fish.

recipes.food_safety_en: Cook freshwater fish thoroughly (liver-fluke risk when raw/under-cooked); cook the pork stuffing through.
common_mistakes_foreigners_en: Starting on very high heat (burnt skin, raw inside)
recipes.cultural_notes_en: Grilled river fish with a chilli dip and sticky rice is one of the most everyday Northern meals.
